# `tlgr emoji`

3 operations. Every one takes the global flags (`--json`, `--plain`, `-a/--account`, `--results-only`, `--select`, `--dry-run`, `--yes`, `--no-input`, `--flood-wait-max`, `-v`) anywhere on the line.

| Command | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`emoji get`](#tlgr-emoji-get) | Resolve custom emoji ids to their documents |
| [`emoji list`](#tlgr-emoji-list) | Server-provided emoji groups and default lists used by the pickers |
| [`emoji search`](#tlgr-emoji-search) | Find emoji by keyword, or custom emoji matching an emoji |

### `emoji get`

Resolve custom emoji ids to their documents.

```
tlgr emoji get [EMOJI_ID]... [OPTIONS]
```

**returns `Page[Sticker]`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EMOJI_ID` | int | any number | Custom emoji document ids. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--convert` | png|json|none | `none` | Post-process downloads: TGS to Lottie JSON. |
| `--download` | path |  | Download the documents into here. |
| `--from-message` | text |  | Take every id used in this message. |

```console
$ tlgr emoji get 5312836234 --json
```

### `emoji search`

Find emoji by keyword, or custom emoji matching an emoji.

```
tlgr emoji search <QUERY> [OPTIONS]
```

**paginated (`LOCAL` cursor) · returns `Page[EmojiKeyword]`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUERY` | text | yes | A keyword, or an emoji with --custom. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--custom` | flag |  | Custom emoji suggestions for the query emoji. |
| `--lang` | text |  | Keyword languages to search. |
| `--suggest-url` | flag |  | Print the login URL for suggesting new keywords. |
| `--sync` | flag |  | Refresh the cached keyword database before searching. |

Pagination is transport-level: `--limit/-n`, `--cursor TOKEN`, `--all` (walked inside the daemon, paced by the account's own rate limiter).

```console
$ tlgr emoji search grinning --json
```
